metadata.description: Lint and de-conflict agent skill descriptions and cut the skill catalog's token cost

plugins.name: skill-tidy
plugins.description: Keep an agent's skill catalog cheap and unambiguous: lint SKILL.md descriptions against the Agent Skills spec and host limits, explain and fix skills that compete for the same prompts without losing triggers, find never-used skills and hide them to save tokens, and audit the always-loaded startup context. Research-backed rules that refresh themselves (evergreen). Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor.
